Results.ReviewText: Started showing rust on area's that are covered and also not covered by warranty. I purchased a Weber for its perceived quality. With a 10 year warranty only on some parts and then expecting the owner to fix it themselves isn't actually the best user experience I look for. Will be looking to explore other options in the future. That future being soon, since my Weber isn't operable due to rust. I also purchased a Weber cover and maintained the grill indoors and covered. Still rusted sadly. I did enjoy using it for its convenience but I am not happy with its long term quality.

Results.ReviewText: It is attractive on the deck, hides the propane tank, easy to use and the steaks, salmon and asparagus we have grilled since getting it have all turned out to be amazing and restaurant quality. It is also very easy to keep it clean and maintain it. We love it!
Results.Title: Purchase of Weber Spirit - 210 Grill.

Results.ReviewText: 2nd Weber grill, last one owned for 8 years and still going strong----just wanted a new one----gave old one to a new home.
Results.Title: QUALITY, DURABILITY, minimal maintenance

Results.ReviewText: I have had several Weber grills over the years and I have left them in the ground when I moved. I own a smokey joe and love it. I bought the Spirit E 210 after doing my research. I love the excellent design and the quality build. I use it almost daily. I really like the easy clean up and outstanding drip collection. I cannot think of anything right now that I dislike or wish that it was different.
Results.Title: Worth the Money

Results.ReviewText: This is our third Weber, the only BBQ to own, has great warranty.
Results.Title: Nothing like a Weber

Results.ReviewText: My nearly new grill was blown over in a severe storm (despite being secured to the deck railing) on a second floor deck. We found parts all over the back yard including knobs, grill cover, flavorizer bars and grates. We found all of the pieces and were able to put the grill back together. Unfortunately the hinge on the lid was broken and the entire lid had to be replaced. I ordered the part and at first Weber sent a lid for the wrong model. After a few emails back and forth, and perhaps a misunderstanding of the situation on Weber's part, Weber decided to sent the correct lid at no charge even though I had agreed to pay for the part. That is excellent customer service and support on the part of Weber!
Results.Title: Well made grills, great customer service

Results.ReviewText: Easy to put together and to use. I love the tank volume indicator and its a perfect size for a family of 4. I bought it mostly for the durable reputation Weber has. I’ve only had it a month so I really can’t tell about that yet but, I hope it lives up to its rep.
Results.Title: Grillin’ NH

Results.ReviewText: This E-210 replaces a 10-year old Genesis grill.  First impression - it has been designed with lighter weight materials and construction.  I would not expect this one to last 10 years; if I am lucky it might make 5 years.  But then again the same is true of me.
Results.Title: Older Weber customer

Results.ReviewText: For the price, I am disappointed with the overall construction of the grill.  The side tables are extremely flimsy.  The cover is light weight.  The grates are supposed to be porcelainized cast iron.  I clean and oil the grates before and after each use and they have begun to rust.  This is at least my 4th Weber grill and believe it may be my last.
Results.Title: Disappointed

Results.ReviewText: Super easy setup, easy use, cleaning. Excellent grill.

Results.Title: Weber Gas Grill

Results.ReviewText: After only two months of use the "stainless steel" cover for the burner controls were corroded. Not what you would expect from a high price grill.
Results.Title: Corrosion

Results.ReviewText: The grill is very well made of quality materials.  The lid is somewhat hard to raise up for me as I am short.  The thing I don't like is they made a bracket on the inside of the storage area to hang the propane tank.  I guess they never tried to lift a heavy propane tank up onto a little hanger brackett while crawling inside the storage area.  They should have just made the bottom of the storage area flat instead of having a huge hole in there that the tank slides right through to the ground.  Very poor design especially for older people with arthritis and back trouble.  Other than that, it is a very nice grill and it cooks very evenly.
Results.Title: Poor design for the propane tank storage.

Results.ReviewText: Great grill! Perfect 2 burner, very dependable and will fit your needs.

46110001.Description:
Taste the difference a Spirit will make in your life. With features such as porcelain enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking. Designed to fit on a small patio or balcony, the Spirit E-210 gas grill brings grilling to any home.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 360 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
